title: YouTube Channel Scraper: Public Stats & Latest Videos
description: Scrape public YouTube channel stats and latest-video summaries. Accepts channel URLs, @handles, or search keywords.

channelUrls.title: Channel URLs
channelUrls.description: YouTube channel URLs or @handles to scrape, for example https://www.youtube.com/@mkbhd or @mkbhd.
channelUrls.sectionDescription: Provide YouTube channel URLs or handles. Both full URLs and @handles are accepted.

searchKeywords.title: Search Keywords
searchKeywords.description: Optional keywords used to find public YouTube channels. Search results vary by region and ranking.
searchKeywords.sectionDescription: Optional: search YouTube for channels by keyword.

maxChannels.title: Max Channels from Search
maxChannels.description: Maximum number of channels to scrape from each search keyword.

maxVideosPerChannel.title: Max Videos Per Channel
maxVideosPerChannel.description: Number of latest public videos to scrape per channel.

includeShorts.title: Include Shorts
includeShorts.description: Include videos detected as YouTube Shorts.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for browser requests. The default Apify Proxy configuration is recommended.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Configure proxies to avoid rate limiting.
